facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: pressure release during a planned shutdown on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-3222 and PT-3222 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 28 December 2017 an incident occurred on P-3222 and PT-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
